limitations: Matching-only results do not enforce or demonstrate full-LPF harmonic feasibility.
Full-LPF runs are finite-grid local SLSQP starts; none met IL <= 0.30 dB and all five optimizers were nonconverged.
The one 35 dB-category candidate met the threshold only within 1e-5 dB numerical feasibility tolerance and remains far from the IL target.
Dense checks use 21 samples per CSV segment and are not continuous-band proofs.
No SRF, Q(f), parasitic, EM, tolerance, manufacturing, or physical signed-coupling feasibility validation was run.
S1/S2/S3 forecasts are run-time estimates only; none of those full-LPF scales was started.

A bounded fixed-topology Full-LPF manager, small multistart and staged uniform-grid experiments exist; full-alphabet/cost-bin topology generation, broad/global search and locally adaptive frequency refinement remain unimplemented.
EXP-034/035/036/037 contained unremapped checkpoint port IDs; those runs are lifecycle/throughput evidence only. Correctly mapped candidate evidence begins at EXP-038.
EXP-041 0.318693 dB 30dB-stage point is feasible only within a 1e-5 dB tolerance; raw H2/H3 minima are about 3e-9 dB below exact 30 dB. The 0.30 dB objective remains unmet.
